dependsOn.note: P0 affinity matrix can start immediately (DISARMED). P1 skill binding benefits from WS-I L7 bind metadata. P2 runFleet policy should follow WS-J P0 outcome gate.

phases.P0-affinity: LLM affinity matrix + role-registry patch proposal (DISARMED)

armingNote: P0 produces JSON + markdown proposals only. P1 skill injection is advisory footer (zero spend). P2 auto-spawn requires glm/ollama/cline fleet arm flags + owner ruling.

subtasks.prompt: Read _SYSTEM/reports/YURI_SKILLS_ORCHESTRATION_UPGRADE_2026-06-30.md §5 and §4 P0. Include ollama tiers (flash/kimi/nemotron/deepseek-pro), cline models (glm-5.2/kimi/deepseek), GLM tiers, native lanes. DISARMED — config only. Return 02K1_AFFINITY_MATRIX_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Draft _SYSTEM/reports/MURE_ROLE_REGISTRY_PATCH_PROPOSAL.md: propose DISARMED changes to role-registry.mjs (extend SUBSTRATES: ollama|cline|deepseek-advisory; resolveLane reads llm-affinity-matrix; optional substrateProfiles on roles in fleet-roles.json). Include unified diff for role-registry.mjs only — do NOT apply fleet-roles.json without owner. Validate proposal against role-registry.test.mjs expectations. Return 02K2_REGISTRY_PATCH_PROPOSAL_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Synthesize affinity matrix into _SYSTEM/reports/MURE_SUBSTRATE_LATTICE_2026-06-30.md: mermaid diagram of role→substrate→model edges; name 5 cross-domain transfers (e.g. Fugu Conductor→quartermaster+MLP, Voyager skills→skill-role-bindings). Return 02K3_SUBSTRATE_LATTICE_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Inventory skills/ and map top 40 skills to MURE roles. Produce _SYSTEM/config/skill-role-bindings.json with schema {bindings:[{role,skills[],trigger[],priority}]}. Cross-check skill-hash-registry.json paths. Document retired skills to exclude (parallel-clone-orchestrator etc). Return 02K6_SKILL_BINDINGS_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Implement _SYSTEM/Scripts/skill-role-resolver.mjs: load skill-role-bindings.json + skill-hash-registry; export resolveSkillsForRole(role, need[], taskClass) → [{skillId, path, hash}]. Unit tests in skill-role-resolver.test.mjs. DISARMED-safe pure functions. Return 02K7_SKILL_RESOLVER_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Wire skill-role-resolver + capability-recall into planCompany/buildRolePrompt as advisory footer (skill titles + paths, NOT full SKILL.md inline unless <2k tokens). Log skillsLoaded[] on plan manifest. Spec in _SYSTEM/mure/SKELETON_BIND_SPEC.md section 'skill dispatch'. Depends WS-K-P1-K1. Return 02K8_PLAN_SKILL_HOOK_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Attack skill-role-bindings.json: false triggers, role-skill overlap, missing adversarial-verification on adjudicator, gitnexus on mechanic. List gaps + minimum fixes before P1 wire. Return 02K10_SKILL_BIND_REVIEW_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Implement substratePolicy in runFleet.mjs: read llm-affinity-matrix + role per leaf; auto-build ollama/cline sidecar tasks when profile.sidecarEligible; document spawn commands in manifest. DISARMED default (dry-run commands only). MoA flag: optional second round dispatches synthesist aggregator leaf. Return 02K11_SUBSTRATE_POLICY_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Design _SYSTEM/config/substrate-quota.template.json for Marcel to fill private caps (glm-max monthly, ollama concurrent=3, cline flat, anthropic weekly). Wire read-only quota hints into runFleet plan output. No live API polling in P2. Return 02K12_QUOTA_TEMPLATE_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Distill WS-K research + task JSON into owner-facing 1-page brief _SYSTEM/reports/MURE_WS_K_OWNER_BRIEF.md: what changes for Marcel day-to-day, arming steps, first GLM build order. Return 02K13_WS_K_BRIEF_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Red-team P2 substrate auto-spawn: runaway sidecars, echo chamber if adjudicator on same substrate, skill footer token bloat, MLP overriding affinity. Publish failure modes in _SYSTEM/reports/MURE_WS_K_P2_REDTREAM.md. Return 02K14_P2_REDTREAM_X_PASS_COMMITTED.
